effort_x1.note: X1 (EFFORT_SIBLING_RANDOMISE): oracle-lane goals by sha256 of the goal id; on = evolve siblings as configured, off = none. verified_rate over settled (verified + regressed); two-sided Fisher exact.

checker_family.note: F2 (CHECKER_FAMILY_RANDOMISE): oracle-lane goals by sha256(checker-family:goal id) (from v2: checker-family:<version>:goal id; one version per section, never pooled); same = checker on the runtime default, cross = CHECKER_CROSS_MODEL; security checker unchanged. One row per goal (its last completed checker with a verdict). outcome: verified = 1, maker_failure = 0, reviewer/environment failures excluded — the checker's own rejection is part of maker_failure, so outcome_wo_checker relabels from the other failed gates only and outcome_survival uses merge survival (checker-independent; few labels until drafts settle). kappa: binary (accepted vs not). delta_kappa_ci: seeded two-sample bootstrap 95 %. fisher_p: agree/disagree × arm; weak_fisher_p: weak-assertion diffs caught/missed × arm. Primary (EXP-1): outcome_survival once ≥ target per arm have settled, else outcome_wo_checker; outcome (attributed) is secondary and circular. Pre-registered stop at CHECKER_FAMILY_TARGET_PER_ARM (default 93) labelled goals per arm on the primary label; before it the read is interim and the verdict collecting; falsified if the Δkappa CI includes 0.

fail_before_pass_after.note: R2 (FAIL_BEFORE_PASS_AFTER_MODE, shadow): per run its latest non-superseded maker; arms = shadow_status pass vs fail (skipped excluded). 14-d merge survival; decision only on the first 40 settled runs (difference >= 10 pt and two-sided Fisher p < 0.05 = SUPPORTED, else FALSIFIED); below 40 descriptive counts only.

knowledge_gaps.note: knowledge_gap judgments of the last 14 d: failure signatures recurring >= 3x (maker failures / regressed) and expert abstentions (no_capability_match); each announces a candidate capability (never promoted)

negative_evidence.note: shadow only: a negative_evidence_match judgment per matched registry entry at proposal creation, dream mutant generation and discovery unit admission; nothing is blocked. exact_pattern = forbidden_code_patterns substring, keyword = match_terms on word boundaries. proposals.verified = matched proposals that later verified (false-positive signal); verified_share null while none settled. registry_entries null = registry file unreadable.

falsifier.note: evidence-room test artefacts (30 d) run at origin/main: red at base, then re-run on later main for 14 d; settled_green = red→green with an imported module changed (one skill_outcomes row, domain falsifier). unknown = infra / not run / unrelated green, never a negative

graded_vs_labels.note: one graded score per run (deciding maker lease); labels: proposal status verified, pr_outcome.survived. Report only

settlement_execution.note: merged loop PRs ≥ 14 d: their test files re-run at origin/main (removed = every test file gone; unknown = infra / timeout / not run, never a negative), then a kill share against fresh seeded mutants of the target vs the maker-time score. metrics.definition: One event per token-consuming record created in the window: worker_leases (runtime ≠ manual; field runtime_usage), judgments with input+output tokens > 0 (field tokens), llm_model_calls (field tokens) except mirrors — consumer maker (owner: the lease), consumer jev with tokens (owner: the judgment rows), purpose transport:* (owner: the caller row), attempts = 0 (never sent). id = sha256(source|row_id|field)[0:32]; exactly one primary owner. judgments rows of one runJudgments call (same subject, state_hash, model, tokens, second) are one shared call, split equally at write. Tokens: provider_reported (runtime / provider usage) else UNKNOWN; no estimator exists, so estimated is always null.

The task population is fixed first: self_improvements created in the window. A usage event belongs to a member when its run (lease loop_run → goal.improvement_id, model call run_id) or its judgment subject (self_improvement; loop_run; worker_lease → its run; specialist_panel → self_improvements.panel_id) leads to that member. Every such event in [since, now) counts — unsuccessful, unverified, cancelled and retried attempts and their reviewers included. Events that lead to no member are reported as unattributed, never spread over the population.

Σ reconciled tokens of the population (cost.population) ÷ population members with status verified. censored = members not yet in a terminal status (verified, regressed, infra_failed, no_change, archived).
Σ tokens of the population reviewer leases (checker, security_checker) ÷ those leases completed with verdict accepted | needs_revision | rejected.
Σ reconciled tokens of the population ÷ loop PRs of population runs with pr_outcome.state = merged. censored = population PRs still open.
Σ reconciled tokens of the population ÷ population PRs in SETTLED_SURVIVED (14 d, merge-survival). censored = MERGED_SURVIVAL_PENDING, never a failure.

population tokens on runs whose maker outcome failed (skill_outcomes loop-maker:*, task_id = run, success 0) ÷ population tokens on runs with a maker outcome; window = the same over every run-linked event in the window.
tokens of reviewer leases without a valid verdict (failed, cancelled, or insufficient_evidence): population, and window = every reviewer lease created in the window.

notes: Read-only: derived from worker_leases, judgments, llm_model_calls, host_power_samples, merge settlements; no row is written or rewritten.
Coverage = per source, events with provider-reported tokens ÷ events × the source window coverage (ledger start, lost windows); the weakest source wins. UNKNOWN is null, never 0.
Opencode lease totals include cache reads/writes: tokens_provider_reported.other = total − prompt − completion (unsplit until maker token accounting).

Population first (cost.population): numerators are everything the population consumed, failed and retried attempts included; successful_only is the survivorship-biased contrast, not the metric. Per-unit values under partial coverage are lower bounds.
